stmts: Ek NIC kai ASGs ka hissa ho sakta hai
Ek hi rule mein ASGs VNets ke aar paar use ho sakte hain
ASGs rules mein IP addresses manage karne ki zaroorat kam karte hain
ASGs har region ke liye bante hain
D4-117.exp: Ek NIC kai application security groups ka hissa ho sakta hai. Ek rule ke tamam ASGs ek hi VNet mein hone chahiye. ASGs aap ko IP addresses ke bajaye application role se rules likhne dete hain. Yeh regional resources hain.

D4-118.q: Kaun si managed service FQDN rules aur threat intelligence ke sath centralized, stateful Layer 3–7 filtering deti hai?
D4-118.exp: Azure Firewall managed, stateful firewall service hai jo Layer 3 se Layer 7 tak filter karti hai. Yeh FQDN-based application rules, network rules, DNAT aur threat-intelligence filtering support karti hai, aur centrally manage hoti hai. NSGs basic Layer 3/4 filters hain, ASGs NICs group karte hain, aur route tables traffic ka rukh badalti hain.

D4-119.q: Azure Firewall ko kaun sa subnet naam chahiye?
D4-119.exp: Azure Firewall ko bilkul AzureFirewallSubnet naam ke dedicated subnet mein deploy karna hota hai, kam az kam /26, taa ke woh scale ho sake. Doosre naam qabool nahi hote, aur GatewaySubnet VPN aur ExpressRoute gateways ke liye reserved hai.

D4-120.q: Bastion ke zariye RDP ke liye target VMs ko AzureBastionSubnet se kaun sa port allow karna chahiye?
D4-120.exp: Bastion target VMs se AzureBastionSubnet se RDP (3389) ya SSH (22) par privately connect hota hai. Is liye VMs ke NSGs ko yeh ports Bastion subnet se allow karne chahiye — internet se nahi. Users khud Bastion tak 443 par pohanchte hain, lekin woh Bastion ki taraf hai, VMs ki nahi.

D4-121.q: Kya ek Bastion host peered VNet ki VMs tak pohanch sakta hai?
opts: Haan — Bastion peered VNets ki VMs se connect karna support karta hai
Nahi — har VNet ko apna Bastion host chahiye
Sirf global peering disabled hone par
Sirf Premium SKU aur VPN ke sath
D4-121.exp: Azure Bastion apne VNet se peered VNets ki VMs tak pohanch sakta hai, is liye hub mein ek Bastion tamam spokes ki VMs serve kar sakta hai. Yeh regional aur global peering aur Basic SKU ke sath chalta hai.

D4-122.q: Kaun si Bastion SKU muft, shared hai, aur sirf dev/test ke liye ek waqt mein ek connection ke sath hai?
D4-122.exp: Bastion ki Developer SKU muft hai aur shared infrastructure use karti hai, is liye AzureBastionSubnet ya public IP nahi chahiye. Yeh ek waqt mein ek connection deti hai aur sirf dev/test ke liye hai. Basic, Standard aur Premium dedicated, paid deployments hain.

D4-123.q: Kaun si Bastion SKU session recording aur private-only deployment add karti hai?
D4-123.exp: Bastion ki Premium SKU graphical session recording aur private-only deployment add karti hai, jis mein Bastion ka koi public IP nahi hota aur private connection se pohancha jata hai. Standard native client support aur shareable links add karti hai, Basic sirf browser hai, aur Developer muft shared option hai.

D4-124.q: Kya Bastion Basic ko Standard mein upgrade kar sakte hain?
D4-124.exp: Aap Bastion host ko usi jagah Basic se Standard (ya Premium) mein upgrade kar sakte hain, redeploy kiye baghair. Downgrade nahi ho sakta; neeche ki SKU par wapas jane ke liye Bastion delete kar ke dobara deploy karein.

D4-125.q: RDP sirf request par, 3 ghante ke liye, request karne wale ke IP se khulna chahiye. Kaun sa feature?
D4-125.exp: Microsoft Defender for Cloud mein just-in-time (JIT) VM access RDP jaise management ports band rakhta hai. Jab koi access mange to yeh waqti taur par NSG rule add karta hai jo request karne wale ke IP se ek muddat (maslan 3 ghante) tak RDP allow kare, phir usay hata deta hai. Permanent NSG rule har waqt khula rehta hai.

D4-126.q: Service endpoint kahan enable karte hain?
D4-126.exp: Service endpoints subnet par enable hote hain: zaroorat ki services chunein, jaise Microsoft.Storage ya Microsoft.Sql. Phir PaaS resource ka firewall VNet rule se us subnet ko allow kar sakta hai. Yeh VMs par ya Entra ID mein set nahi hote.

D4-127.q: VMs ko service endpoint ke zariye sirf EK makhsoos storage account tak pohanchna chahiye, tamam storage accounts tak nahi. Kaun sa feature?
D4-127.exp: Akela service endpoint subnet ko Azure ke har storage account tak pohanchne deta hai. Service endpoint policy endpoint traffic ko aap ke list kiye makhsoos storage accounts tak mehdood karti hai, jo data ko doosre accounts mein copy hone se rokne mein madad karti hai. Storage tag wale NSG rules accounts mein farq nahi kar sakte.

D4-128.q: Jab VM storage service endpoint use karti hai to storage account kaun sa source IP dekhta hai?
opts: Public IP ke bajaye VM ka private IP (subnet identity)
VM ka public IP, ya us ke NAT gateway ka public IP address
D4-128.exp: Service endpoint ke sath Azure Storage ka traffic public IP ke bajaye VM ka private IP aur subnet ki identity le kar jata hai. Isi wajah se storage firewall us subnet ke VNet rule se match kar pata hai.

D4-129.q: Service endpoint enable karne ke baad VM ke public IP ko allow karne wala storage firewall IP rule match karna band kar deta hai. Kyun?
opts: Traffic ab private source IP ke sath aata hai, is liye IP rule ke bajaye VNet rule chahiye
Service endpoint add hone par IP rule expire ho jata hai, is liye dobara banana parta hai
Service endpoints storage block karte hain
D4-129.exp: Service endpoint on hone ke baad subnet ka traffic VM ke private IP aur subnet identity ke sath Storage tak pohanchta hai, public IP ke sath nahi. Is liye purana IP rule ab match nahi karta. Is ke bajaye subnet ka VNet rule add karein. Firewall rules reset ya expire nahi hote.

D4-130.q: Private endpoints ke peeche kaun si Azure service hai?
D4-130.exp: Private endpoints Azure Private Link ka hissa hain: private endpoint aap ke VNet mein woh network interface hai jo PaaS service ya Private Link service se privately jurta hai. Front Door, Traffic Manager aur Network Watcher shamil nahi.

D4-131.q: Aap apni app Standard load balancer ke peeche publish karte hain taa ke doosre tenants ke consumers usay privately pohanch sakein. Kaun sa feature?
D4-131.exp: Private Link service aap ki apni app (Standard load balancer ke peeche) ko Private Link par rakhti hai, is liye doosre VNets ya tenants ke customers us tak private endpoints bana kar privately pohanch sakte hain. Peering ki zaroorat nahi, aur service endpoints sirf Azure PaaS services ke sath chalte hain.

D4-132.q: On-premises clients ko VPN ke zariye private endpoint ka FQDN resolve karna hai. Recommended design?
opts: Queries ko Azure DNS Private Resolver ke inbound endpoint par forward karein
Private endpoint ka A record public Azure DNS zone mein publish karein
D4-132.exp: On-premises DNS servers seedhe Azure private DNS zones query nahi kar sakte. Privatelink zone se linked VNet mein inbound endpoint ke sath Azure DNS Private Resolver deploy karein, phir apne on-premises DNS ko privatelink.* zones us endpoint ke IP par conditionally forward karne ke liye set karein. Public DNS public IP deta hai, aur hosts files scale nahi hoti.

D4-133.q: Private endpoint connection 'Pending' dikhata hai. Kya chahiye?
opts: Resource owner ko connection approve karna hoga
Subnet par service endpoint on karna hoga
D4-133.exp: Agar private endpoint banane wale ke paas target resource par permission na ho to connection Pending mein intezar karta hai jab tak resource ka owner usay approve na kare (resource ke Private endpoint connections ke neeche). VNet dobara banana, service endpoints add karna ya DNS badalna usay approve nahi karta.

D4-134.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Private endpoint tak peered VNet se pohancha ja sakta hai
Private endpoint ke liye service ka public endpoint disable karna zaroori hai
Subnet par network policies enabled hon to private endpoints NSG aur UDR policies support karte hain
Har private endpoint ek makhsoos resource (aur sub-resource) se map hota hai
D4-134.exp: Private endpoint tak peered VNets aur on-premises se pohancha ja sakta hai. Service ka public endpoint disable karna optional hai, halan ke recommended hai. Subnet par network policies enabled hon to NSGs aur UDRs private endpoint traffic par apply hote hain. Har private endpoint ek resource aur sub-resource (maslan blob) se map hota hai.

D4-135.q: Requirement: on-premises servers ko public endpoints ke baghair ExpressRoute par Azure SQL Database tak privately pohanchna hai. Kya chunenge?
D4-135.exp: Sirf private endpoint Azure SQL Database ko aisa private IP deta hai jis tak on-premises servers ExpressRoute ya VPN par pohanch sakein, public network access disabled ke sath. Service endpoints sirf Azure subnets se kaam karte hain, public endpoint private nahi, aur peering PaaS services ke bajaye VNets jorti hai.

D4-136.q: Requirement: VNet ki VMs ko sab se kam cost aur baghair DNS changes ke storage account tak pohanchna hai, aur account ka public endpoint reh sakta hai. Kya chunenge?
opts: Service endpoint plus VNet firewall rule
Private endpoint aur private DNS zone
D4-136.exp: Service endpoint muft hai aur DNS changes nahi mangta: subnet par enable karein aur storage firewall mein VNet rule add karein, aur account ka public endpoint waisa hi rehta hai. Private endpoint ke paise lagte hain aur privatelink DNS chahiye. ExpressRoute aur Bastion apply nahi hote.

D4-137.q: Private endpoint mojood hone ke bawajood VM mystorage.blob.core.windows.net ko public IP par resolve karti hai. Mumkin wajah kya hai?
opts: privatelink.blob.core.windows.net private DNS zone VM ke VNet se linked nahi
Storage firewall mein private endpoint wale subnet ka VNet rule nahi
D4-137.exp: Private endpoint sirf un clients ke liye kaam karta hai jo naam ko private IP par resolve karein. Agar privatelink.blob.core.windows.net zone VM ke VNet se linked nahi — ya VNet aisa custom DNS server use karta hai jo Azure DNS ko forward nahi karta — to naam public IP par resolve hota hai. NSGs, firewall aur redundancy name resolution par asar nahi dalte.

D4-138.q: Kaun sa Network Watcher feature diagnose karta hai ke NSGs source aur destination ke darmiyan traffic allow karte hain ya nahi, har evaluate hua rule dikhate hue?
D4-138.exp: Network Watcher NSG diagnostics check karta hai ke source se destination tak traffic allowed hoga ya nahi, aur raste mein evaluate hua har NSG aur rule aur aakhri faisla dikhata hai. Topology diagram banata hai, packet capture traffic record karta hai, aur VPN troubleshoot gateways check karta hai.

D4-139.q: Ek VM ka 'Effective security rules' view khali ya unavailable hai. Aam wajah kya hai?
opts: Effective rules dikhane ke liye VM chal rahi honi chahiye
Yeh view sirf public IP wali Windows VMs support karta hai
D4-139.exp: Effective security rules (aur effective routes) chalte network interface se parhe jate hain, is liye VM chal rahi honi chahiye. Agar stopped ya deallocated ho to view khali ya unavailable hota hai. Yeh Linux aur Windows dono ke liye chalta hai, Bastion use ho ya nahi.

D4-140.q: Virtual network flow logs kahan likhe jate hain, aur Traffic Analytics unhein kaise use karta hai?
opts: Storage account, jo Log Analytics workspace mein process hota hai
Event Hub, jo Microsoft Sentinel workspace mein stream ho
D4-140.exp: Flow logs storage account mein likhe jate hain. Phir Traffic Analytics unhein Log Analytics workspace mein process karta hai, jo maps aur dashboards deta hai. Event Hub Traffic Analytics ka destination nahi, aur flow logs NSG ya DNS mein store nahi hote. Naye NSG flow logs ab nahi ban sakte, aur mojooda 30 September 2027 ko retire honge.

D4-141.q: Microsoft NSG flow logs retire kar raha hai. Recommended replacement kya hai?
D4-141.exp: Microsoft NSG flow logs ko virtual network flow logs ke haq mein retire kar raha hai, jo poore VNet (ya subnet ya NIC) par enable hote hain aur woh traffic bhi capture karte hain jo NSGs nahi dekhte. Packet capture, Activity log aur Connection Monitor alag kaam karte hain. NSG flow logs 30 September 2027 ko retire honge, aur naye ab nahi ban sakte.

D4-142.ctx: Subnet Web par nsg-web hai: priority 100 Internet se TCP 443 Allow; priority 200 203.0.113.0/24 se TCP 443 Deny. VM1 ke NIC par koi NSG nahi.
D4-142.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: 203.0.113.5 wala client 443 par VM1 tak pohanch sakta hai
198.51.100.7 wala client 443 par VM1 tak pohanch sakta hai
Default rules ke tehat VM1 outbound internet tak pohanch sakti hai
Usi VNet ki doosri VM port 22 par VM1 tak pohanch sakti hai (NSG rules ke hisaab se)
D4-142.exp: Rule 100 tamam internet clients ke liye pehle match karta hai, 203.0.113.5 samet, is liye 200 wala deny kabhi apply nahi hota; default outbound internet allow karta hai; AllowVnetInBound VNet ke andar port 22 allow karta hai.

D4-143.q: Pichle scenario mein 443 par baqi sab ko allow karte hue 203.0.113.0/24 ko kaise block karein?
opts: Deny rule ko allow se kam priority number dein
NIC NSG mein zyada priority number ke sath deny add karein
D4-143.exp: NSG rules sab se kam number se process hote hain. 443 par baqi sab ko allow karte hue 203.0.113.0/24 block karne ke liye us range ke deny ka number wide allow se kam hona chahiye — maslan deny 90 par aur allow 100 par. Allow delete karne se sab block ho jayenge, aur routes traffic filter nahi karte.

D4-144.q: Kaun si service VNet ke public IPs ke liye DDoS ke khilaf adaptive tuning, attack telemetry aur cost protection add karti hai?
D4-144.exp: Har public IP ko muft basic DDoS infrastructure protection milti hai. Azure DDoS Network Protection (ya per-IP DDoS IP Protection) aap ke traffic ke liye adaptive tuning, attack telemetry aur alerts, aur attack ke dauran scale-out ke liye cost protection add karti hai. NSGs aur Bastion DDoS kam nahi karte.

D4-145.q: Azure Firewall ko apne public IP par port 3389 ka inbound traffic VM ke private IP par translate karna hai. Kaun sa rule type?
D4-145.exp: Azure Firewall mein DNAT (destination network address translation) rule firewall ke public IP aur port par aane wale traffic ko VNet ke andar private IP aur port par translate karta hai, yahan 3389 par VM. Network rules IP aur port se allow ya deny karte hain, application rules FQDN se filter karte hain, aur threat intelligence maloom malicious IPs block karta hai.

D4-146.q: Outbound web access sirf *.microsoft.com tak allowed hona chahiye. Kaun sa Azure Firewall rule type?
D4-146.exp: Azure Firewall application rules outbound HTTP aur HTTPS ko FQDN se filter karte hain, *.microsoft.com jaise wildcards samet. Network rules sirf IP addresses aur ports ke sath kaam karte hain, DNAT rules inbound translation ke liye hain, aur NSGs domain naam se filter nahi kar sakte.

D4-147.q: Service endpoints ke bare mein kaun si DO baatein sahi hain?
opts: Yeh har subnet aur har service ke liye configure hote hain
Yeh VNet identity ko service tak le jate hain
Yeh PaaS resource ko private IP dete hain
Yeh on-premises networks se kaam karte hain
D4-147.exp: Service endpoints har subnet aur har service (maslan Microsoft.Storage) ke liye on hote hain, aur subnet ki identity service tak le jate hain taa ke us ka firewall us subnet ko allow kar sake. Service phir bhi apna public IP use karti hai — koi private IP nahi — aur yeh on-premises se kaam nahi karte. Un zarooraton ke liye private endpoints use karein.

D4-148.q: Azure Bastion deploy karne ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Bastion resource banayen (SKU, public IP)
VNet mein AzureBastionSubnet (/26 ya bara) banayen
Portal se Bastion ke zariye VM se connect karein
Yaqeeni banayen ke VM NSGs Bastion subnet se RDP/SSH allow karte hain
D4-148.exp: Pehle AzureBastionSubnet (/26 ya bara) banayen, kyun ke Bastion us mein deploy hota hai. Phir SKU aur public IP ke sath Bastion resource banayen. Yaqeeni banayen ke target VMs ke NSGs Bastion subnet se RDP ya SSH allow karte hain. Aakhir mein portal se connect karein.

D4-149.q: Bastion hub mein deployed hai, aur VMs peered spoke mein hain. Kya spoke VMs ko public IPs chahiye?
D4-149.exp: Nahi. Bastion VMs se un ke private IPs par connect hota hai, aur yeh VNet peering ke aar paar chalta hai, is liye spoke VMs ko public IPs nahi chahiye. Yeh Bastion ka ek bara faida hai, OS ya SKU chahe kuch bhi ho.

D4-150.ctx: VNet1/SubnetA par Microsoft.Storage service endpoint hai. Storage account st1 VNet rule ke zariye sirf SubnetA allow karta hai. SubnetB mein st1 (blob) ka private endpoint hai, DNS sahi configured hai.
D4-150.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: SubnetA ki VM st1 ke blobs access kar sakti hai
SubnetB ki VM private endpoint ke zariye st1 ke blobs access kar sakti hai
VPN par on-premises server private endpoint ke zariye st1 access kar sakta hai (DNS forwarding configured ke sath)
On-premises server SubnetA ke service endpoint ke zariye st1 access kar sakta hai
D4-150.exp: VNet rule SubnetA ko allow karta hai; private endpoint traffic firewall se block nahi hota; on-premises private endpoint use kar sakta hai; service endpoints on-premises tak nahi jate.

opts: DNS zones host karne wali service jo Microsoft ke global name servers se naam resolve karti hai
Domain registrar jo domain names bechta hai aur har saal khud renew karta hai
D4-151.exp: Azure DNS DNS zones host karta hai — internet-facing domains ke liye public zones aur VNets ke liye private zones — Microsoft ke global name servers network par, is liye aap Azure tools se records manage karte hain. Yeh domain names nahi bechta, traffic load-balance nahi karta ya VPN connections nahi deta.

D4-152.q: Kaun si CLI command contoso.com ke liye public DNS zone banati hai?
opts: az network dns zone create -g RG1 -n contoso.com
az network zone add -g RG1 -n contoso.com --dns
D4-152.exp: az network dns zone create -n contoso.com Azure DNS mein public DNS zone banati hai, aur us ke output mein woh name servers hote hain jo aap registrar par set karte hain. Private zone ke liye az network private-dns zone create use karein. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D4-153.q: Kaun si CLI command zone contoso.com mein A record 'www' → 20.1.2.3 add karti hai?
opts: az network dns record-set a add-record -g RG1 -z contoso.com -n www -a 20.1.2.3
az network dns add-record -g RG1 --zone contoso.com --type A --name www --value 20.1.2.3
D4-153.exp: az network dns record-set a add-record zone mein A record add karti hai: -z zone hai, -n record ka naam (www) aur -a IPv4 address. Agar record set abhi mojood nahi to Azure usay bana deta hai. Har record type ki apni subcommand hai, jaise cname ya mx.

D4-154.q: Kaun sa record type ek naam ko doosre naam (alias) se map karta hai, maslan www → contoso.azurewebsites.net?
D4-154.exp: CNAME record ek naam ko doosre ka alias banata hai, maslan www.contoso.com → contoso.azurewebsites.net. A record naam ko IPv4 address se map karta hai, MX mail handle karta hai aur PTR reverse lookups karta hai.

D4-155.q: Kaun sa record type domain ki email ko mail servers ki taraf bhejta hai?
D4-155.exp: MX (mail exchange) records domain ki email lene wale mail servers ki list dete hain, har ek ki priority ke sath. TXT SPF aur verification values jaisa text rakhta hai, SRV doosri services dhoondta hai, aur NS zone delegate karta hai.

D4-156.q: Kya CNAME record set mein ek se zyada record ho sakte hain?
opts: Nahi — CNAME record sets mein sirf ek record ho sakta hai
Haan — CNAME record set mein 20 records tak ho sakte hain
D4-156.exp: CNAME record set mein sirf ek record ho sakta hai, kyun ke ek naam sirf ek doosre naam ka alias ho sakta hai. CNAMEs zone apex par bhi nahi ho sakte. A, AAAA aur TXT record sets mein bohat se records ho sakte hain.

D4-157.q: Aap ko subdomain dev.contoso.com ko alag Azure DNS zone ko delegate karna hai. Parent zone contoso.com mein kya add karenge?
opts: Child zone ke name servers ke sath NS record set 'dev'
CNAME record 'dev' jo child zone ke SOA ki taraf ho
D4-157.exp: dev.contoso.com ko us ke apne Azure DNS zone ko delegate karne ke liye child zone (dev.contoso.com) banayen aur parent zone mein dev naam ka NS record set add karein, child zone ke name servers ki list ke sath. CNAME, A aur TXT records delegate nahi karte.

D4-158.q: DNS record par kam TTL ka kya asar hota hai?
opts: Tabdeeliyan jaldi phailti hain, lekin queries barh jati hain
Records jaldi delete hote hain, is liye zone chhota rehta hai
D4-158.exp: TTL (time to live) yeh hai ke resolvers record ko kitni der cache kar sakte hain. Kam TTL ka matlab caches jaldi expire hote hain, is liye changes clients tak jaldi pohanchte hain, lekin resolvers aap ke name servers se zyada baar poochte hain. Yeh records ko private ya delete nahi karta.

D4-159.q: Production DNS zone aur us ke records ko ghalti se delete hone se kaise bachayen?
opts: Zone par CanNotDelete resource lock lagayen
Zone par Audit effect wali Azure Policy assign karein
D4-159.exp: DNS zone par CanNotDelete resource lock kisi ko bhi zone (aur us ke sath har record) ghalti se delete karne se rokta hai. Record sets ko alag alag bhi mehfooz kiya ja sakta hai. Azure Policy Audit sirf report karti hai, TTL caching ke bare mein hai, aur private zone public users ko serve nahi karega.

D4-160.q: Kaun sa RBAC role user ko doosre resources badle baghair DNS zone mein records manage karne deta hai?
D4-160.exp: DNS Zone Contributor user ko DNS zones aur un ke record sets manage karne deta hai, lekin un tak kis ka access hai yeh nahi aur subscription mein kuch aur nahi. (Private zones ke liye is ka barabar Private DNS Zone Contributor hai.) Network Contributor tamam networking cover karta hai, Contributor sab kuch, aur Reader sirf dekhne ke liye hai.

D4-161.q: Kaise check karein ke Azure DNS ko delegation kaam kar raha hai?
opts: nslookup -type=SOA contoso.com chala kar confirm karein ke Azure name servers jawab dete hain
Azure Advisor ke reliability page par delegation recommendation check karein
Azure name servers ke port 53 par IP flow verify chalayen
D4-161.exp: Bahar se domain query karein, maslan nslookup -type=SOA contoso.com ya nslookup -type=NS contoso.com. Agar Azure ke name servers (ns1-xx.azure-dns.com waghera) jawab dein to delegation kaam kar raha hai. Ping zones ke bajaye hosts test karta hai, aur Advisor aur IP flow verify DNS check nahi karte.

D4-162.q: Azure DNS kaun se alias record target types support karta hai?
opts: Public IPs, Traffic Manager, Front Door/CDN aur usi zone ke record sets
Storage accounts, VMs, key vaults, SQL databases aur koi bhi external IP address
D4-162.exp: Alias records Azure public IP address, Traffic Manager profile, Azure Front Door ya CDN endpoint, ya usi zone ke doosre record set ki taraf point kar sakte hain, aur target badalne par khud update hote hain. Yeh external IPs, storage accounts ya load balancer backend pools ki taraf point nahi kar sakte.

D4-163.q: Kaun si CLI command private DNS zone ko auto-registration ke sath VNet1 se link karti hai?
opts: az network private-dns link vnet create -g RG1 -z contoso.local -n link1 -v VNet1 -e true
az network vnet update -g RG1 -n VNet1 --private-dns-zone contoso.local --register-vms true
D4-163.exp: az network private-dns link vnet create private DNS zone (-z) ko VNet (-v) se link karti hai, aur -e true (registration enabled) VM records ki auto-registration on karta hai. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D4-164.q: Ek VNet kitne private DNS zones se auto-registration enabled ke sath link ho sakta hai?
D4-164.exp: VNet resolution ke liye bohat se private DNS zones se link ho sakta hai, lekin un mein se sirf ek link par auto-registration enabled ho sakti hai. Warna VMs kai zones mein register ho jatin.

D4-165.q: VNet1 aur VNet2 (peered) ki VMs ko private zone corp.local ke zariye ek doosre ke naam resolve karne hain. Aap kya karenge?
opts: corp.local ko dono VNets se link karein
D4-165.exp: Private DNS zone sirf us se linked VNets ki queries ka jawab deta hai, aur peering DNS share nahi karti. corp.local ko VNet1 aur VNet2 dono se link karein (auto-registration ke sath agar VM records khud banne chahiye), aur dono ki VMs ek doosre ko resolve kar sakti hain. Akela Azure-provided DNS sirf ek VNet ke andar kaam karta hai, aur public zones naam zahir kar denge.

D4-166.q: On-premises servers ko DNS VMs deploy kiye baghair Azure private DNS zone ke naam resolve karne hain. Kaun si service?
D4-166.exp: Azure DNS Private Resolver managed service hai, is liye DNS VMs ki zaroorat nahi. Is ke inbound endpoint ko aap ke VNet mein IP milta hai jis par on-premises DNS servers forward karte hain, jo unhein Azure private DNS zones ke naam resolve karne deta hai. Public zones, Traffic Manager aur Bastion yeh nahi karte.

D4-167.q: Azure VMs ko on-premises domain (corp.contoso.com) ke naam resolve karne hain. Private Resolver ke kaun se components?
opts: Outbound endpoint plus VNet se linked DNS forwarding ruleset
Inbound endpoint aur usi domain naam ka public DNS zone
D4-167.exp: Azure VMs ko on-premises domain resolve karwane ke liye Private Resolver outbound endpoint aur DNS forwarding ruleset (rule: corp.contoso.com → aap ke on-premises DNS IPs) deploy karein, VNet se linked. Inbound endpoints ulti direction handle karte hain, on-premises se Azure ki taraf.

D4-168.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Private DNS zones internet se resolve ho sakte hain
Private DNS zone alag regions ke VNets se link ho sakta hai
Auto-registration VMs ke private IPs ke records banati hai
Private zone ka naam public domain naam jaisa ho sakta hai (split-horizon)
D4-168.exp: Private DNS zones sirf un se linked VNets se resolve hote hain, internet se nahi. Zone kisi bhi region ke VNets se link ho sakta hai. Auto-registration VMs ke private IPs ke records banati hai. Private zone ka naam public domain jaisa ho sakta hai (split-horizon), jo andar aur bahar alag jawab deta hai.

D4-169.q: Azure Load Balancer ke main components kya hain?
opts: Frontend IP, backend pool, health probe, load-balancing rules
Profile, endpoints, routing method aur endpoint monitor settings
D4-169.exp: Azure Load Balancer frontend IP configuration (jahan traffic aata hai), backend pool (jo VMs usay lete hain), health probes (jo backends check karte hain) aur load-balancing rules (jo kisi port ke liye frontend, backend aur probe ko jorte hain) se bana hai. Listeners aur URL maps Application Gateway ke hain, profiles aur endpoints Traffic Manager ke, aur gateways aur connections VPN ke.

D4-170.q: Kaun si CLI command Standard public load balancer banati hai?
opts: az network lb create -g RG1 -n lb1 --sku Standard --public-ip-address pip1
az network loadbalancer add -g RG1 -n lb1 --tier Standard --frontend-ip pip1
D4-170.exp: az network lb create load balancer banati hai. --sku Standard SKU set karta hai, --public-ip-address frontend ke taur par Standard public IP attach karta hai, aur aap frontend aur backend pool ka naam rakhte hain. Probes aur rules baad mein add karein. Baqi commands mojood nahi.

D4-171.q: HTTP probe ke liye aam tor par kaun si default health probe settings use hoti hain?
opts: 5 second interval, port 80 par /health jaisa path
Interval 60 minute, backend ke port 80 par ICMP echo
D4-171.exp: Health probes default mein har 5 second backends check karte hain. HTTP probe port 80 jaise port par /health jaisa path request karta hai aur 200 OK ki tawaqqo rakhta hai. Probes TCP, HTTP ya HTTPS ho sakte hain; ICMP supported nahi, aur 60 minute ka interval bohat slow hoga.

D4-172.q: /health par HTTP health probe 302 (redirect) return karta hai. Probe ka nateeja kya hai?
opts: Unhealthy — HTTP probes ko 200 status chahiye
Healthy — 200 se 399 tak har status pass hota hai
D4-172.exp: HTTP ya HTTPS probe sirf 200 OK response ko healthy maanta hai. 302 redirect, 404 ya kuch aur failure ginta hai, is liye us instance ko naye connections milna band ho jate hain. Probe ko aise path ki taraf point karein jo redirect kiye baghair 200 de.

D4-173.q: Azure Load Balancer load-balancing rules mein kaun se protocols support karta hai?
opts: TCP aur UDP (ya HA ports ke sath All)
D4-173.exp: Azure Load Balancer Layer 4 load balancer hai, is liye is ke rules TCP ya UDP handle karte hain (ya internal load balancer par HA ports ke sath All). Yeh HTTP ya HTTPS nahi samajhta, aur ICMP load-balance nahi ho sakta.

D4-174.q: Standard load balancer ke backend pool mein kaun se resources ho sakte hain?
opts: Ek VNet mein VMs ya VMSS instances (NIC ya IP address se)
Duniya ke kisi bhi VNet ki VMs, bas VNets globally peered hon
D4-174.exp: Standard load balancer ke backend pool mein VMs ya scale set instances (NIC se, ya IP address se add kiye gaye) ho sakte hain jo sab ek VNet mein hon. Yeh duniya bhar ke VNets mein nahi phail sakta, aur App Service apps aur storage accounts backends nahi ban sakte.

D4-175.q: Standard internal load balancer ke peeche VMs ka koi outbound internet access nahi. Kyun?
opts: Standard internal LBs outbound SNAT nahi dete
NSG ke default rules internet ki taraf outbound deny karte hain
D4-175.exp: Internal Standard load balancer sirf network ke andar se inbound traffic handle karta hai. Yeh backend VMs ko outbound internet access nahi deta (koi SNAT nahi). NAT Gateway jaisa explicit outbound tareeqa add karein. NSGs default mein outbound internet allow karte hain, is liye woh wajah nahi.

D4-176.q: Load-balancing rule par Floating IP (direct server return) option kya karta hai?
opts: Backend ko bheje packets mein frontend IP ko destination rakhta hai
Tamam backends unhealthy hone par frontend IP ko paired region mein le jata hai
D4-176.exp: Aam tor par load balancer packets backend ko us ke apne IP ko destination bana kar deliver karta hai. Floating IP (direct server return) is ke bajaye frontend IP ko destination rakhta hai, jo SQL Server Always On listeners jaise clusters ko chahiye. Yeh IPs dynamic nahi banata, regions ke darmiyan move nahi karta ya WAF add nahi karta.

D4-177.q: Azure Load Balancer par TCP flows ka default idle timeout kya hai, aur kya yeh badal sakta hai?
opts: 30 second, 4 minute tak configure ho sakta hai
D4-177.exp: Azure Load Balancer ka TCP idle timeout default mein 4 minute hai aur barhaya ja sakta hai (load-balancing rules par 100 minute tak). Itni der baghair traffic ke connection drop ho jata hai. Aap TCP reset bhi enable kar sakte hain taa ke idle connection band hone par clients ko bataya jaye.

D4-178.q: Public Standard load balancer par outbound rule ka maqsad kya hai?
opts: Backend VMs ke liye outbound SNAT explicitly configure karna
Backend VMs ka traffic on-premises networks tak route karna
D4-178.exp: Public Standard load balancer par outbound rule outbound SNAT explicitly set karta hai: backend VMs outbound internet traffic ke liye kaun se public IPs use karein aur har VM ko kitne SNAT ports milein. Inbound RDP inbound NAT rules use karta hai, on-premises routing gateways use karti hai, aur TLS termination Layer 7 feature hai.

D4-179.q: Kaun sa load balancer global frontend IP use kar ke regions ke darmiyan Layer 4 par traffic baantta hai?
opts: Global peering wala internal load balancer
D4-179.exp: Global load balancer (pehle cross-region) ka global anycast frontend IP hota hai aur yeh Layer 4 traffic ko regional Standard load balancers mein baantta hai, regions ke darmiyan failover karte hue. Internal load balancers ek region ke liye private hain, Application Gateway regional Layer 7 hai, aur NAT Gateway sirf outbound traffic handle karta hai.

D4-180.q: Public Standard LB se do VMs par web traffic load-balance karne ke steps tarteeb mein lagayen:
items: Load-balancing rule banayen (TCP 80, frontend → backend pool, probe)
Standard public IP frontend ke sath LB banayen
VMs ke NICs backend pool mein add karein aur health probe banayen
VMs ke NSGs mein port 80 allow karein
D4-180.exp: Pehle Standard public IP frontend ke sath load balancer banayen. VMs ke NICs backend pool mein add karein aur health probe banayen. Phir TCP 80 ke liye frontend, pool aur probe ko jorne wala load-balancing rule banayen. Aakhir mein VMs ke NSGs mein port 80 allow karein, kyun ke Standard default mein band hota hai.

D4-181.q: Kaun si DO shartein Standard LB ko backend VM par koi traffic na bhejne ki wajah banti hain?
D4-181.exp: Backend VM ko koi traffic nahi milta agar us ka health probe fail ho (load balancer usay rotation se nikal deta hai) ya NSG traffic allow na kare (Standard SKU default mein usay block karti hai). Disk type aur VM ka availability zone load balancing par asar nahi dalte.

D4-182.q: Health probe tamam backends down dikhata hai, lekin VMs par app locally chalti hai. Aap ko kya check karna chahiye?
opts: Ke probe port/path jawab de aur probe source block na ho
Ke DNS TTL kam ho aur frontend IP propagate ho chuka ho
D4-182.exp: Health probes 168.63.129.16 (AzureLoadBalancer service tag) se aate hain. Check karein ke app asal mein probe ke port aur path par sun rahi hai, aur na guest firewall na NSG us source ko block kar raha hai. Storage tier, DNS TTL aur budgets probes par asar nahi dalte.

D4-183.q: Backend VM load balancer ke apne frontend IP tak nahi pohanch sakti (hairpin), lekin bahar ke clients pohanch sakte hain. Kyun?
opts: Backend instance ka apne LB frontend se connect karna, jab flow wapas usi par aaye, supported nahi
NSG outbound traffic block karta hai
DNS masle se VNet ke andar frontend naam ghalat address par resolve hota hai, is liye flow kho jata hai
D4-183.exp: Azure Load Balancer hairpinning support nahi karta: jab backend VM apne load balancer ke frontend IP se connect kare aur flow wapas usi VM par bheja jaye to woh fail hota hai. Bahar ke clients par asar nahi. Service ko seedha call karein ya alag design use karein, jaise alag internal frontend.

D4-184.q: Kaun sa Load Balancer metric dikhata hai ke backend instances health probes paas kar rahe hain ya nahi?
D4-184.exp: Health Probe Status metric (DipAvailability) dikhata hai ke har backend instance apna health probe paas kar raha hai ya nahi. Data Path Availability dikhata hai ke khud frontend pohanch mein hai ya nahi, SNAT count outbound connections ke bare mein hai, aur byte count throughput hai.

D4-185.q: Bhaari load mein load balancer ke peeche VMs se kabhi kabhi outbound connection failures aate hain. Mumkin wajah aur hal?
opts: SNAT port exhaustion; NAT Gateway use karein ya zyada outbound IPs/ports allocate karein
DNS throttling; record TTL kam karein ya doosra custom DNS server lagayen
D4-185.exp: Har VM ko load balancer ke zariye outbound connections ke liye mehdood SNAT ports milte hain. Bhaari load mein yeh khatam ho jate hain, aur naye outbound connections kabhi kabhi fail hote hain. NAT Gateway (ya outbound rules mein zyada outbound IPs aur allocated ports) kahin zyada SNAT capacity deta hai. DNS TTL, NSG priority aur disks ka taluq nahi.

D4-186.q: Kaun sa Azure Monitor experience load balancer ka topology aur metrics dashboard deta hai?
D4-186.exp: Azure Monitor mein Load Balancer Insights load balancer ke frontends, backends aur rules ka topology view deta hai, sath mein health aur data path availability ke ready-made metric dashboards. VM insights VMs ke liye hai, Container insights containers ke liye, aur Advisor recommendations deta hai.

D4-187.q: Kaun sa Application Gateway feature api.contoso.com aur www.contoso.com ki requests ko alag backend pools par route karta hai?
D4-187.exp: Application Gateway par multi-site listeners requests ko host name (Host header) se route karte hain, is liye api.contoso.com aur www.contoso.com usi gateway par alag backend pools par jate hain. Path-based routing is ke bajaye URL path se baantti hai. HA ports aur inbound NAT Azure Load Balancer ke hain.

D4-188.q: Application Gateway ko kaun sa subnet setup chahiye?
D4-188.exp: Application Gateway ko apne dedicated subnet mein deploy karna hota hai, jis mein doosre resources nahi ho sakte (naam aap ki marzi). GatewaySubnet VPN aur ExpressRoute gateways ke liye reserved hai, aur AzureBastionSubnet Bastion ke liye.

D4-189.q: Kaun sa Application Gateway feature apps ko SQL injection aur cross-site scripting se bachata hai?
opts: OWASP rule sets ke sath Web Application Firewall (WAF)
Adaptive tuning rules wali DDoS network protection
D4-189.exp: Application Gateway par Web Application Firewall HTTP requests ko managed OWASP Core Rule Set rules ke khilaf inspect karta hai aur SQL injection aur cross-site scripting jaise attacks block karta hai. NSGs Layer 4 par kaam karte hain, DDoS protection traffic ke sailab handle karti hai, aur health probes backends check karte hain.

D4-190.q: Kaun si service DNS se globally load-balance karti hai (priority, weighted, performance, geographic routing)?
D4-190.exp: Azure Traffic Manager DNS use kar ke globally traffic baantta hai: yeh routing method (priority, weighted, performance, geographic waghera) ke mutabiq behtareen endpoint ke sath DNS queries ka jawab deta hai. Azure Load Balancer aur Application Gateway regional hain, aur NAT Gateway outbound traffic ke liye hai.

D4-191.q: Global web app ko edge TLS termination, caching, WAF aur Layer 7 par regions ke darmiyan tez failover chahiye. Kaun si service?
D4-191.exp: Azure Front Door Microsoft ke edge par global Layer 7 entry point hai: yeh users ke qareeb TLS terminate karta hai, content cache karta hai, web application firewall rakhta hai aur regions ke darmiyan tez failover karta hai. Traffic Manager sirf DNS se kaam karta hai, aur internal load balancer aur NAT Gateway regional hain.

D4-192.q: Andar ka non-HTTP traffic (TCP 1433) VNet ke andar SQL VMs mein baantna hai. Kya chunenge?
D4-192.exp: Internal Standard load balancer Layer 4 par kaam karta hai, is liye VNet ke andar private frontend IP par TCP 1433 ko SQL VMs mein baant sakta hai. Application Gateway aur Front Door HTTP(S) ke liye hain, aur Traffic Manager DNS-based aur public hai.

D4-193.q: 3 zones mein phaili VMs ke liye kaun sa combination zone-redundant Layer 4 load balancing deta hai?
opts: Zone-redundant frontend aur zones 1, 2, 3 mein backend VMs wala Standard LB
Zonal frontend wala Basic LB aur availability set mein backend VMs
D4-193.exp: Zone-redundant frontend wala Standard load balancer zone fail hone par serve karta rehta hai, aur zones 1, 2 aur 3 mein phaili backend VMs app available rakhti hain. Basic load balancer retire ho chuka aur kabhi zones support nahi karta tha, Traffic Manager region ke andar load-balance nahi karta, aur Application Gateway v1 Layer 7 hai aur zone support nahi.

D4-194.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Standard LB ek backend pool mein do alag VNets ki VMs mila sakta hai
Inbound NAT rule frontend port range ko pool ki kai VMs se map kar sakta hai
Health probe HTTPS use kar sakta hai
Basic public IP Standard LB ke sath use ho sakta hai
D4-194.exp: Standard load balancer ka backend pool ek VNet mein hona chahiye. Inbound NAT rules frontend port range ko pool ki kai VMs se map kar sakte hain. Health probes HTTP, HTTPS aur TCP support karte hain. Standard load balancer ko Standard public IPs chahiye — SKUs mix nahi ho sakti (aur Basic public IPs retire ho chuke).

D4-195.q: Kaun sa load balancer type Standard LB frontend se chained, traffic path mein third-party NVAs ko transparently dalta hai?
D4-195.exp: Gateway load balancer third-party network virtual appliances (jaise firewalls) ko Standard load balancer ke frontend ke traffic path mein transparently ('bump in the wire') chain karta hai, is liye aap routes badle baghair NVAs dal ya scale kar sakte hain. Baqi options appliances chain nahi karte.

D4-196.q: App ko port 443 ka TCP traffic backend port 8443 par balance karna hai. Kya yeh mumkin hai?
opts: Haan — load-balancing rules frontend port ko alag backend port se map karte hain
Nahi — rule ke frontend aur backend ports match hone chahiye, siwaye UDP ke
D4-196.exp: Har load-balancing rule ka apna frontend port aur backend port hota hai, is liye 443 par aane wala traffic VMs par 8443 ko bheja ja sakta hai. Is ke liye Application Gateway ya HA ports nahi chahiye.

D4-197.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Azure DNS public zones ke liye DNSSEC signing support karta hai
Alias record apex ko Traffic Manager profile ki taraf point kar sakta hai
CLI se Azure DNS mein zone file import ho sakti hai
Azure DNS public zones ko VNet link chahiye
D4-197.exp: Azure DNS public zones ke liye DNSSEC signing support karta hai. Alias record zone apex ko Traffic Manager profile ki taraf point kar sakta hai. CLI se zone file import ho sakti hai (az network dns zone import). Public zones internet par pohanch mein hote hain, is liye unhein VNet links nahi chahiye — sirf private zones ko.

D4-198.q: Standard LB ke peeche VMSS ko har client ko 30 minute tak usi instance par bhejna hai. Aap kya use karenge?
opts: Rule par session persistence (Client IP) plus munasib idle timeout
Rule par Floating IP on aur 30 minute ka health probe interval
D4-198.exp: Client IP par set session persistence ek client IP ka tamam traffic usi scale set instance par bhejti hai. Isay munasib idle timeout ke sath milayen taa ke session ke dauran connections drop na hon. Floating IP, HA ports aur outbound rules client ko ek instance par nahi rakhte.

D4-199.ctx: Requirements: 2 regions mein public HTTPS web app, regions ke darmiyan failover, URL path routing (/api ko API servers par), WAF protection, aur API servers ki cache layer ke liye internal TCP service.
D4-199.q: Kaun sa design behtareen match karta hai?
opts: Front Door (global L7, WAF) → regional Application Gateways (path routing) → cache layer ke liye internal Standard LB
Traffic Manager (global DNS) → regional NAT Gateways (path routing) → cache layer ke liye public Basic LB
D4-199.exp: Front Door web application firewall ke sath global Layer 7 entry point deta hai aur dono regions ke darmiyan failover karta hai. Har region mein Application Gateway URL path se /api ko API servers par route karta hai. Internal Standard load balancer TCP cache layer ko privately handle karta hai. Ek Basic load balancer, akela Traffic Manager ya NAT Gateway yeh sab poora nahi kar sakte.

D4-200.ctx: contoso.com Azure DNS ko delegated hai. Apex par pip-lb (LB1 ka Standard public IP) ki taraf alias record hai. LB1 par TCP 80 rule aur /health par health probe hai. VMs par NSG Internet se port 80 allow karta hai.
D4-200.q: Haan ya Nahi mein jawab dein:
stmts: Agar pip-lb ko naye IP resource se badla jaye to alias record khud update hota hai
Agar kam az kam ek backend probe healthy ho to clients http://contoso.com par app tak pohanch sakte hain
Apex par alias ke bajaye CNAME use ho sakta tha
Agar tamam VMs par /health 500 de to traffic phir bhi deliver hota hai
D4-200.exp: Alias referenced resource ke IP changes track karta hai, lekin resource ko NAYE resource se badalne ka matlab alias target update karna hai; healthy backends traffic serve karte hain; CNAMEs apex par nahi ho sakte; tamam probes down hon to delivery nahi hoti.

D4-241.q: Aap aise template se naya VNet banate hain jo 31 March 2026 ke baad wala API version use karta hai. Us ki VM ke paas na public IP hai, na NAT gateway, na load balancer, aur woh internet tak nahi pahunchti. Kyun?
opts: Naye VNets default NSG rule se tamam outbound traffic block karte hain
VNet ko internet traffic ke liye service endpoint chahiye
Naye VNets ke subnets default mein private hain, is liye default outbound IP nahi
VM size accelerated networking ke baghair outbound connections support nahi karta
D4-241.exp: 31 March 2026 ke baad wale API versions mein naye VNets ke subnets default mein private hote hain, is liye VMs ko default outbound IP nahi milta. Explicit tareeqa lagayen: NAT gateway (recommended), load balancer outbound rules, NIC par Standard public IP, ya route ke sath firewall. Mojooda VNets nahi badalte.

D4-242.q: Private subnet ki VM ko outbound internet access kaun si DO cheezein deti hain?
opts: VM ke NIC par Standard public IP
VNet se linked private DNS zone
D4-242.exp: Private subnet mein default outbound access nahi hota, is liye VM ko explicit tareeqa chahiye, jaise subnet par NAT gateway ya NIC par Standard public IP. Load balancer outbound rules ya route ke sath firewall bhi kaam karte hain. Private endpoints aur private DNS zones internet access nahi dete.

D4-243.q: Aap ko ek VNet ka IP traffic record karna shuru karna hai, us ke VPN gateway ka traffic bhi. Aap kya enable karenge?
opts: Har subnet par NSG flow logs
D4-243.exp: Virtual network flow logs VNet ke workloads ka traffic record karte hain, VPN gateways samet. Naye NSG flow logs ab nahi ban sakte, aur woh 30 September 2027 ko retire honge. Packet capture VMs par mukhtasar, tafseeli traces ke liye hai, aur Activity log management operations record karta hai.
